raw.details:
Hackathon Guidelines: Eligibility & Team

  • Team Composition: Minimum 3 members and maximum 5 members. 
  • Team Leader: Each team must designate one leader.
  • Cross-College Teams Allowed: Members can be from different colleges.
  • Restriction: A student can participate in only one team.

Competition Structure:

  • Idea Submission Open:
    • Opens: 10 Sept 2026
    • Teams must upload a presentation (PPT/PDF) before 3rd Oct 2026 describing their problem statement and proposed solution in the format given below.
    • PPT Format must include:
      • Problem details
      • Innovative approach
      • Feasibility and implementation plan
  • Idea Submission Deadline:
    • Deadline: 30 Sept 2026, 12:00 AM IST
    • Teams must complete registration and idea submission before the deadline.
    • Each team must have 3–5 members with one designated leader.
    • Cross-college teams are allowed.
    • A participant can join only one team.
  • Round 1 – Idea Presentation:
    • Date: 08 Oct 2026, 11:08 PM IST
    • Teams will present their ideas before the evaluation panel.
    • Judging Criteria: Creativity, technical depth, feasibility, and potential impact.
  • Round 1 – Final Selection List:
    • Announcement: 09 Oct 2026, 09:00 AM IST
    • Shortlisted teams will be announced.
    • Only these teams qualify for Round 2.
  • Registration for Round 2:
    • Deadline: 15 Oct 2026, 09:00 AM IST
    • Only shortlisted teams from Round 1 can register.
    • Registration Fee: ₹1000 per head (non-refundable)
  • Round 2 – Offline Hackathon (24-Hour Challenge):
    • Start: 01 Nov 2026, 09:00 AM IST
    • End: 02 Nov 2026, 09:00 AM IST
    • Teams will work continuously for 24 hours to develop their prototype.
    • Evaluation will be based on innovation, execution, teamwork, and applicability.
  • Prize Distribution & Winner Announcement:
    • Date: 02 Nov 2026, 01:00 PM IST
    • Results will be declared after evaluation.
    • Winning teams will receive prizes, certificates, and recognition during the closing ceremony.

Themes & Broad Problem Areas:

Problem Statements

Track 1: Edge AI & Computer Vision

PS-01: AI-Based Smart Campus Safety System
Develop an edge-AI solution that can detect potentially unsafe situations such as crowding, falls, unauthorized entry, or abnormal activity using cameras and provide real-time alerts without continuously sending sensitive video data to the cloud.

PS-02: Intelligent Road Hazard Detection
Develop an on-device computer vision system that identifies potholes, road cracks, obstacles, pedestrians, and other hazards in real time and provides alerts to drivers or authorities.

PS-03: AI-Based Waste Segregation
Build an intelligent system capable of identifying different categories of waste using computer vision and automatically assisting in segregation at the point of disposal.

PS-04: Smart Retail Shelf Monitoring
Develop an edge-AI solution that detects empty shelves, misplaced products, and inventory conditions using cameras and provides real-time notifications.

Track 2: Healthcare & Assistive Technology

PS-05: AI-Powered Assistive System for Visually Impaired People
Develop a portable intelligent device that uses computer vision and on-device AI to identify obstacles, objects, signs, or people and communicate useful information through audio or haptic feedback.

PS-06: Edge AI-Based Elderly Fall Detection
Develop a privacy-preserving system that detects when an elderly person falls and automatically generates an emergency alert without requiring continuous cloud processing.

PS-07: Intelligent Stress & Wellness Monitor
Develop an edge-AI system that analyzes physiological or behavioral signals to estimate stress/wellness levels in real time and provide personalized recommendations.

PS-08: Smart Medicine Management System
Develop an intelligent connected device that helps users manage medication schedules, detects missed doses, and provides alerts to caregivers when necessary.

Track 3: Smart City & Sustainability

PS-09: Intelligent Traffic Management
Develop an edge-AI system that analyzes traffic conditions in real time and dynamically recommends signal timing or traffic-routing strategies to reduce congestion.

PS-10: Smart Energy Optimization
Build an IoT and Edge AI solution that monitors electricity consumption and intelligently recommends or automatically implements energy-saving actions.

PS-11: AI-Based Water Leakage Detection
Develop a sensor-based intelligent system that detects abnormal water flow or leakage and generates real-time alerts to minimize water wastage.

PS-12: Smart Air Quality Monitoring
Develop a low-cost connected device that monitors environmental parameters and uses edge intelligence to identify pollution patterns and provide actionable alerts.

Track 4: Smart Mobility & Robotics

PS-13: Intelligent Autonomous Delivery Robot
Design a small autonomous robot capable of navigating a defined environment, avoiding obstacles, identifying its destination, and safely delivering objects.

PS-14: AI-Based Driver Assistance System
Develop an edge-AI solution capable of detecting driver distraction, drowsiness, lane departure, or nearby obstacles and generating timely warnings.

PS-15: Smart Agricultural Rover
Develop an autonomous agricultural robot that can monitor crops, identify plant health conditions, detect weeds, or assist with precision agriculture.

PS-16: Search-and-Rescue Intelligent Robot
Develop a robotic system capable of navigating hazardous or difficult environments while detecting people, obstacles, temperature anomalies, or other indicators useful during rescue operations.

Track 5: Connected Intelligence & IoT

PS-17: Smart Home Energy Guardian
Develop an intelligent IoT system that monitors household appliances and automatically identifies unnecessary energy consumption and abnormal usage patterns.

PS-18: Intelligent Industrial Monitoring System
Develop an edge-IoT solution that monitors machines using sensors and detects abnormal operating conditions before equipment failure occurs.

PS-19: Smart Agriculture Monitoring Platform
Build an IoT system that monitors soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and other agricultural parameters & uses AI to recommend irrigation or crop-management actions.

PS-20: Connected Disaster Alert System
Develop a resilient IoT-based system capable of detecting conditions such as floods, fires, earthquakes, or other environmental hazards and distributing local emergency alerts even when conventional connectivity is limited
